A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete 29-page versions of the same study, with matching main sections and Appendices A–O. Text, equations, tables, and figures support a reliable comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original RoBERTa fine-tuning experiments, spectral analyses, forgetting measurements, intruder-scaling interventions, and continual-learning results.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical experiments and analyses, with limited revisions to reported numerical results.

M1.justification: Algorithm 1, the singular-value scaling intervention, and the fine-tuning and continual-learning procedures are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the same six classification tasks, LLaMA instruction-following, math and code coverage, and pre-training-distribution and continual-learning evaluations.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged, including full fine-tuning, LoRA, and the AdaLoRA, LoRA+, PiSSA, and VeRA comparisons in Appendix O. Figure 23 changes line styles, not comparison methods.

E3.justification: Training settings, model configurations, evaluation metrics, and testing procedures remain unchanged in Appendix B and the main text. The numerical revisions do not establish a protocol change or experimental rerun.

E4.justification: The same learning-rate, rank, alpha, dataset-size, initialization, B-only training, intruder-scaling, and continual-learning analyses are retained. No analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Appendix N retains the five-seed experiment. The correlation tests, p-values, and statistical reporting in Section 4 and Appendix F are unchanged.

E6.justification: Table 1's Full row changes: MNLI 0.8617 to 0.8745; SST-2 0.9461 to 0.9438; QQP 0.9146 to 0.9152; WinoGrande 0.6251 to 0.6582; SIQA 0.6551 to 0.6499; FEVER 0.6687 to 0.6892. These now match the unchanged Full row in Table 2. Figure 6(b) also lowers WinoGrande's LoRA rank-1 pre-training pseudo-loss point. These are limited result revisions; the main findings remain unchanged.

T1.justification: Definition 3.1, the mathematical discussion in Appendices A and D, and the gradient derivations in Appendix E are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about spectral intruder dimensions, their role in forgetting, scaling interventions, and accumulation during continual learning.

C2.justification: Mechanism explanations, applicability qualifications, and limitations are retained. Section 4's correction from 'learns less' to 'forgets less' aligns a local restatement with the interpretation already present in v2's introduction and Section 2.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hyperparameters, hardware, runtime information, evaluation tools, and checkpoint access information in Appendices B and K and Table 5 are unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning are unchanged. Section 4's wording correction preserves the relationship to Biderman et al. already explicitly stated in Section 2.

P1.justification: Localized edits correct 'a the range,' 'findings to not just apply,' and Section 4's 'learns less' wording. The publication footer is updated to NeurIPS 2025. Section and appendix organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 23 changes the VeRA rank-256 and rank-512 curves and legend entries to distinguishable solid and dashed styles, retaining their plotted points. The first-page publication information and limited text reflow also change; figure and table organization is retained.

improvement.justification: v3 improves clarity by correcting Section 4's reduced-forgetting statement and distinguishing the VeRA curves in Figure 23. Table 1's full-fine-tuning baseline also becomes consistent with Table 2. These are limited clarity and consistency gains; the numerical revisions are not explained and do not independently establish stronger empirical reliability.
